source_request: Write up your extraction suggestion as a task in root tasks

task.objective: Extract source-backed structural, data-flow, call/dependency and effect features for every function definition in the pinned JavaScript inventory; use these features to group functionally similar implementations and classify behavior without equating Babel syntax or names with semantics.

source_inventory.scope: All inventoried JS files at their recorded pinned source revisions; preserve parse failures and source-byte verification. No unannounced sampling or substitution with newer HEAD revisions.

classification_unit.primary: Individual function definition identified by repository, revision, relative file path, and AST source span.
included_forms: other Babel function-like nodes enabled by the parser
classification_unit.names: Retain explicit, inferred, and null names. Preserve separate definitions with the same name.
classification_unit.nesting: Record parent/child function identity; separate operations directly in the function body from those inside nested functions and callbacks.
classification_unit.aggregation: Group by (enclosing_function_name, enclosing_function_type) as secondary analysis, not as a unique function identifier; reconcile against all 976 existing pairs and null/outside-function cases.

extract: Babel definition type, name and naming context
parameter count and parameter AST patterns (rest/default/destructuring)
async, generator, method kind and static/private flags
source span and containing function identity
exact AST expression node types and counts
arithmetic, logical, comparison, unary, assignment and update operators
call/new expression structures and argument counts
returned values and input-to-output dependencies where resolvable
branch/loop nesting and directly evidenced flow metrics
statically known direct call targets and imports
callee/member access paths and imported aliases
dynamic, computed and indirect call identities left unresolved where necessary
evidence and explicit unknowns when behavior cannot be statically established

ordered_tasks.action: Verify governing repository instructions, source inventories, source hashes, pinned revisions, Babel parser configuration, and coverage baseline.
Reparse each inventoried JavaScript file and enumerate every function-like AST definition, including anonymous and nested definitions; assign stable identities and hierarchy.
Extract all six feature categories via Babel node fields, traversal and lexical scope/binding analysis; preserve source evidence and unknowns; distinguish direct vs nested-body observations.

Link function definitions to existing expression, identifier/member and name/type inventories; produce feature vectors and comprehensive per-definition and aggregate records; preserve zero-expression functions.

Identify similarities using calls/member paths, data flow, effects, operators and control flow; use names only as supporting evidence; classify multi-label behaviors such as computation, transformation, validation, mutation, I/O and orchestration. Keep raw features independent from inferred labels.

Test and reconcile complete file/function coverage, source identities, aggregation, nested scope boundaries, unresolved dynamics and classification evidence against a manually reviewed reference set; persist outputs and independently verify readback.

per_function.evidence: AST types, locations, resolved references, uncertainty

datasets: Combined and per-name/type aggregate index linked to function identities
Call and dependency references and unresolved-analysis diagnostics
Separately versioned functional similarity groups and multi-label classifications
Coverage/error manifest, parser settings, source revisions and tests

guardrails: Do not equate AST declaration type or matching function names with functional equivalence.
Do not treat source occurrence counts as runtime execution frequency.
Do not assert absence of side effects for unresolved calls.
Do not aggregate nested callbacks into the parent function's direct operation counts.
No revision to the planned JSON runtime action vocabulary is required by this extraction task.
No source repo mutations, workflow deployments or runtime changes without explicit separate authorization.
acceptance: Every parseable JS file and function-like definition at the pinned revisions is covered, including anonymous and nested functions and those with zero recorded expressions.
Every definition has a unique source-based identity and separately attributable features.
All six feature categories are extracted with evidence or explicit unresolved markers.
Definitions are reconciled against the 976 prior name/type pairs; null name/type/outside-function cases and all omissions or errors are explained.
Output and clustering are reproducible; classification labels are distinguished from static observations and evaluated against manual review.
Results are persisted with verifiable readback; the task remains pending until implementation and validation are actually completed.
task.execution_boundary: Record task only. Do not run feature extraction as part of task authoring.
